Value.Value: Finding date field to enter T for setting today date in field.
Validating Date input is equal to T. T corresponds to Today date. If T is entered in field, today date will be automatically populated in given field.
This subFlow helps to select Date in a Date picker.
This distinction is useful when same Field label is found in mutliple FastTabs/Sections in the UI.
Using Regular expressions to split Month, day and year from date input.
